_comment: SCA (src/ + xpi/) whose shipped XPI ships a minified background.js, so sca-xpi-fully-included-in-archive stays silent and the input:sca checks run over the src/ source view. The archive commits a lock and sets no registry, so no check that aborts the review fires before the build-hygiene checks this fixture exists for. Each fires twice, so their collapse behaviour is observable: build-lifecycle-hook escalates the postinstall and prepare scripts for a reviewer to read (an escalation, so it is not expressible in `expect` - the golden holds it); committed-build-artifact on the committed dist/addon.zip and dist/legacy.xpi (error, archive extension only - contents irrelevant); committed-node-modules on both committed dependency folders (error, never read - the loader records the directory path only, which is why the repo .gitignore re-includes fixture node_modules). A registry override aborts the review, so it has a fixture of its own (sca-registry-redirect). Traced build paths are sca-root-relative (no src/ prefix).
